WITH eligible_monthly_limits AS ( SELECT limit_card.user_card_id, limit_content.content_version_id, COALESCE(limit_policy.shared_group_key, limit_policy.limit_policy_id) AS limit_group_key, CASE WHEN limit_policy.limit_type = 'reward_amount' AND limit_policy.limit_unit = 'KRW' THEN limit_tier.limit_value WHEN limit_policy.limit_type = 'usage_count' AND limit_policy.limit_unit = 'count' AND offer.value_type = 'fixed_amount' AND offer.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback') THEN limit_tier.limit_value * COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(rule.reward_value) FROM benefit_rules rule WHERE rule.offer_id = offer.offer_id AND rule.rule_effect = 'grant' AND rule.reward_unit = 'KRW' AND rule.current_spend_min_krw IS NULL AND (rule.previous_spend_min_krw IS NULL OR rule.previous_spend_min_krw <= COALESCE(previous_performance.current_spend_amount, 0)) AND (rule.valid_from IS NULL OR rule.valid_from <= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01')) AND (rule.valid_to IS NULL OR rule.valid_to >= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01')) ), 0) ELSE 0 END AS maximum_reward FROM user_cards limit_card INNER JOIN cards limit_card_catalog ON limit_card_catalog.card_id = limit_card.card_id INNER JOIN card_content_versions limit_content ON limit_content.card_id = limit_card_catalog.card_id INNER JOIN card_benefits benefit ON benefit.content_version_id = limit_content.content_version_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers offer ON offer.benefit_id = benefit.benefit_id INNER JOIN benefit_limit_policies limit_policy ON limit_policy.offer_id = offer.offer_id INNER JOIN benefit_limit_tiers limit_tier ON limit_tier.limit_policy_id = limit_policy.limit_policy_id LEFT JOIN user_card_performance_snapshots previous_performance ON previous_performance.user_card_id = limit_card.user_card_id AND previous_performance.performance_month = DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') WHERE limit_policy.limit_period = 'monthly' AND limit_card.user_id = #{userId} AND limit_card.is_active = TRUE AND (limit_policy.valid_from IS NULL OR limit_policy.valid_from <= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01')) AND (limit_policy.valid_to IS NULL OR limit_policy.valid_to >= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01')) AND limit_tier.current_spend_min_krw IS NULL AND (limit_tier.previous_spend_min_krw IS NULL OR limit_tier.previous_spend_min_krw <= COALESCE(previous_performance.current_spend_amount, 0)) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_rules eligible_rule WHERE eligible_rule.offer_id = offer.offer_id AND eligible_rule.rule_effect = 'grant' AND (eligible_rule.previous_spend_min_krw IS NULL OR eligible_rule.previous_spend_min_krw <= COALESCE(previous_performance.current_spend_amount, 0)) AND (eligible_rule.valid_from IS NULL OR eligible_rule.valid_from <= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01')) AND (eligible_rule.valid_to IS NULL OR eligible_rule.valid_to >= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01')) ) AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_offer_option_requirements requirement WHERE requirement.offer_id = offer.offer_id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_offer_option_requirements requirement INNER JOIN user_card_option_selections selection ON selection.user_card_id = limit_card.user_card_id AND selection.option_group_id = requirement.option_group_id AND selection.option_choice_id = requirement.option_choice_id WHERE requirement.offer_id = offer.offer_id ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_limit_tiers higher_tier WHERE higher_tier.limit_policy_id = limit_tier.limit_policy_id AND higher_tier.current_spend_min_krw IS NULL AND (higher_tier.previous_spend_min_krw IS NULL OR higher_tier.previous_spend_min_krw <= COALESCE(previous_performance.current_spend_amount, 0)) AND ( COALESCE(higher_tier.previous_spend_min_krw, 0) > COALESCE(limit_tier.previous_spend_min_krw, 0) OR ( COALESCE(higher_tier.previous_spend_min_krw, 0) = COALESCE(limit_tier.previous_spend_min_krw, 0) AND higher_tier.position > limit_tier.position ) ) ) ), monthly_limit_groups AS ( SELECT user_card_id, content_version_id, limit_group_key, MAX(maximum_reward) AS maximum_reward FROM eligible_monthly_limits GROUP BY user_card_id, content_version_id, limit_group_key ), monthly_card_limits AS ( SELECT user_card_id, content_version_id, SUM(maximum_reward) AS maximum_monthly_benefit_amount FROM monthly_limit_groups GROUP BY user_card_id, content_version_id ) SELECT uc.user_card_id, COALESCE(cv.name, uc.card_name_from_codef) AS card_name, uc.memo AS alias, NULLIF(cv.image_url, '') AS card_image_url, ( SELECT cb.title FROM card_benefits cb WHERE cb.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id AND cb.record_type = 'benefit' ORDER BY cb.position ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS highlight_benefit_title, COALESCE(card_limit.maximum_monthly_benefit_amount, 0) AS maximum_monthly_benefit_amount, COALESCE(benefit_usage.received_benefit_amount, 0) AS received_benefit_amount, COALESCE(performance.current_spend_amount, 0) AS performance_current_amount,
COALESCE( (SELECT next_tier.minimum_spend_krw FROM card_performance_tiers next_tier WHERE next_tier.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id AND next_tier.minimum_spend_krw > COALESCE(performance.current_spend_amount, 0) ORDER BY next_tier.minimum_spend_krw ASC LIMIT 1), (SELECT MAX(last_tier.minimum_spend_krw) FROM card_performance_tiers last_tier WHERE last_tier.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id), cv.representative_spend, 0) AS performance_target_amount, uc.display_order FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id LEFT JOIN card_content_versions cv ON cv.card_id = c.card_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions cv2 WHERE cv2.card_id = cv.card_id AND (cv2.last_seen_at > cv.last_seen_at OR (cv2.last_seen_at = cv.last_seen_at AND cv2.content_version_id > cv.content_version_id)) ) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_card_id, SUM(reward_amount_krw) AS received_benefit_amount FROM user_benefit_usages WHERE usage_status = 'confirmed' AND usage_date >= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01') AND usage_date < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY user_card_id ) benefit_usage ON benefit_usage.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id LEFT JOIN monthly_card_limits card_limit ON card_limit.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND card_limit.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id LEFT JOIN user_card_performance_snapshots performance ON performance.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND performance.performance_month = #{yearMonth} WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY uc.display_order ASC, uc.user_card_id ASC

WITH eligible_limit_rows AS ( SELECT uc.user_card_id, COALESCE(policy.shared_group_key, policy.limit_policy_id) AS limit_group_key, CASE WHEN policy.limit_type = 'reward_amount' AND policy.limit_unit = 'KRW' THEN tier.limit_value WHEN policy.limit_type = 'usage_count' AND policy.limit_unit = 'count' AND offer.value_type = 'fixed_amount' AND offer.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback') AND rule.reward_unit = 'KRW' THEN tier.limit_value * rule.reward_value ELSE 0 END AS limit_amount FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards card ON card.card_id = uc.card_id INNER JOIN card_content_versions content ON content.card_id = card.card_id INNER JOIN card_benefits benefit ON benefit.content_version_id = content.content_version_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers offer ON offer.benefit_id = benefit.benefit_id INNER JOIN benefit_rules rule ON rule.offer_id = offer.offer_id INNER JOIN benefit_limit_policies policy ON policy.offer_id = offer.offer_id INNER JOIN benefit_limit_tiers tier ON tier.limit_policy_id = policy.limit_policy_id LEFT JOIN user_card_performance_snapshots previous_performance ON previous_performance.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND previous_performance.performance_month = DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB(CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.is_active = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions newer WHERE newer.card_id = content.card_id AND (newer.last_seen_at > content.last_seen_at OR (newer.last_seen_at = content.last_seen_at AND newer.content_version_id > content.content_version_id)) ) AND offer.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback', 'points') AND rule.rule_effect = 'grant' AND rule.current_spend_min_krw IS NULL AND (rule.previous_spend_min_krw IS NULL OR rule.previous_spend_min_krw <= COALESCE(previous_performance.current_spend_amount, 0)) AND (rule.valid_from IS NULL OR rule.valid_from <= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01')) AND (rule.valid_to IS NULL OR rule.valid_to >= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01')) AND policy.limit_period = 'monthly' AND (policy.valid_from IS NULL OR policy.valid_from <= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01')) AND (policy.valid_to IS NULL OR policy.valid_to >= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01')) AND tier.current_spend_min_krw IS NULL AND (tier.previous_spend_min_krw IS NULL OR tier.previous_spend_min_krw <= COALESCE(previous_performance.current_spend_amount, 0)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_limit_tiers higher_tier WHERE higher_tier.limit_policy_id = tier.limit_policy_id AND higher_tier.current_spend_min_krw IS NULL AND (higher_tier.previous_spend_min_krw IS NULL OR higher_tier.previous_spend_min_krw <= COALESCE(previous_performance.current_spend_amount, 0)) AND ( COALESCE(higher_tier.previous_spend_min_krw, 0) > COALESCE(tier.previous_spend_min_krw, 0) OR (COALESCE(higher_tier.previous_spend_min_krw, 0) = COALESCE(tier.previous_spend_min_krw, 0) AND higher_tier.position > tier.position) ) ) AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_offer_option_requirements requirement WHERE requirement.offer_id = offer.offer_id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_offer_option_requirements requirement INNER JOIN user_card_option_selections selection ON selection.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND selection.option_group_id = requirement.option_group_id AND selection.option_choice_id = requirement.option_choice_id WHERE requirement.offer_id = offer.offer_id ) ) ), eligible_limit_groups AS ( SELECT user_card_id, limit_group_key, MAX(limit_amount) AS limit_amount FROM eligible_limit_rows WHERE limit_amount > 0 GROUP BY user_card_id, limit_group_key ), monthly_usage_groups AS ( SELECT benefit_usage.user_card_id, COALESCE(policy.shared_group_key, policy.limit_policy_id) AS limit_group_key, SUM(benefit_usage.reward_amount_krw) AS used_amount FROM user_benefit_usages benefit_usage INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = benefit_usage.user_card_id INNER JOIN benefit_limit_policies policy ON policy.limit_policy_id = benefit_usage.limit_policy_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND benefit_usage.usage_status = 'confirmed' AND benefit_usage.usage_date >= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01') AND benefit_usage.usage_date < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY benefit_usage.user_card_id, COALESCE(policy.shared_group_key, policy.limit_policy_id) ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST( limits.limit_amount - COALESCE(usage_group.used_amount, 0), 0)), 0) FROM eligible_limit_groups limits LEFT JOIN monthly_usage_groups usage_group ON usage_group.user_card_id = limits.user_card_id AND usage_group.limit_group_key = limits.limit_group_key

SELECT ubu.usage_id AS benefit_history_id, approval.merchant_name, CASE bo.reward_type WHEN 'discount' THEN 'DISCOUNT' WHEN 'cashback' THEN 'CASHBACK' WHEN 'points' THEN 'POINT' END AS benefit_type, COALESCE(bo.offer_name, cb.title) AS benefit_title, COALESCE(cv.name, uc.card_name_from_codef) AS card_name, approval.amount AS payment_amount, ubu.reward_amount_krw AS benefit_amount, COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) AS occurred_at FROM user_benefit_usages ubu INNER JOIN card_payment_approvals approval ON approval.approval_id = ubu.approval_id INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = ubu.user_card_id INNER JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id LEFT JOIN card_content_versions cv ON cv.card_id = c.card_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions cv2 WHERE cv2.card_id = cv.card_id AND (cv2.last_seen_at > cv.last_seen_at OR (cv2.last_seen_at = cv.last_seen_at AND cv2.content_version_id > cv.content_version_id)) ) INNER JOIN benefit_offers bo ON bo.offer_id = ubu.offer_id INNER JOIN card_benefits cb ON cb.benefit_id = bo.benefit_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND ubu.usage_status = 'confirmed' AND bo.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback', 'points') AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) >= #{fromUtc} AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) < #{toUtc} ORDER BY COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) DESC, ubu.usage_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
